## Verifier Review: #1747

**Decision: FAIL**
**Gates:** red; the device failure was not established as pre-existing. Reviewed PR head `6d35e72102be64336e0e3c855e59b77b6b6b9eab` against merge base `1304a54fcf0ca9692237f1664c6d6b5b8f4bb4d9`; remote head matches.

### Findings

- [MUST FIX] `app/src/main/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/ThreadScreen.kt` → `ThreadScreen` error collectors: collecting suspends inside `errorNotices.show` for the full timeout, so an earlier second signal can remain buffered outside the shared FIFO while a later failure from another route acquires the mutex. Archive A1, Archive A2, then markdown-open B renders A1 → B → A2. A scratch Compose regression through these production collectors reproduced it: after the first timeout, the pill showed “Couldn't open file” instead of the second Archive failure. Consume signals promptly into the common queue while preserving screen/conversation cancellation, and add mixed-route ordering coverage. The same pattern affects new-session, workspace, run-configuration, attachment refusal, attachment-send and markdown-open collectors; enqueue both refusal reasons in their original order before later failures can overtake them. Existing same-route and direct-state tests do not cover this interleaving.
- [MUST FIX] `app/src/androidTest/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/BackgroundTaskPanelCaptureTest.kt` → `compactLargeTextKeepsScrolledContentAndCloseGlyphReachable`: the dispatcher's full UI gate failed with `No compose hierarchies found` at `assertWithinCompactWidth`, with the launcher focused and no ANR. The exact method passed once on the merge base, so there is no matching inherited failure supporting advancement. Resolve the full-sweep failure or establish a matching baseline failure under the triage contract, then obtain fresh dispatcher gates. The test, panel, Gradle configuration and gate script are unchanged by this PR; product causation is unproven. Resizing to 320×640 inside the already-launched Compose activity is a concrete lifecycle lead. A focused pass alone does not establish full-suite acceptance.
- [MUST FIX] `app/src/androidTest/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/settings/ArchiveAppearanceCaptureTest.kt` → `ArchiveAppearanceCaptureTest` and `compactLargeTextKeepsRestoreReachable`: the operator's repair `d5223aa5` changes this sibling capture's lifecycle to `ViewportRule` and moves compact sizing into `@Viewport`, but the architecture plan still has no Files read entry or Revision recording this departure. The [operator repair comment](https://github.com/pyrycode/pyrycode-mobile/pull/1755#issuecomment-5991754129) explains the fix and its successful full UI validation; carry that scope, rationale and validation into the plan. This is a plan-record requirement, not a request to undo the authorized repair.
- [SHOULD FIX] `app/src/sharedTest/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/MarkdownReaderScreenTest.kt` → `copiesOfANoteAtTheReadersBound_areBounded`: remove the obsolete #1759 Ignore. HEAD includes `ef587984`, merged in the current base, which fixes this exact 262,144-character reader crash by breaking long unbroken runs in drawn text. Keeping the skip removes clipboard-bound coverage after its underlying rendering fix has landed. Restore the test and verify it on the device before the next handoff. The separate #1760 pairing-touch ignore remains linked to an open, unresolved issue.

### Gate triage and verification evidence

- Dispatcher command `ANDROID_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py ui` exited **1**. Current `app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/managedDevice/debug/pixel2Api33Atd/TEST-pixel2Api33Atd_0-_app-.xml` confirms **185 executed: 184 passed, 1 failed**, plus **1 skipped**. The sole failure is the BackgroundTaskPanel method named above. The skipped method is `RenameDialogCaptureTest.renameAtFigmaViewport`.
- Required baseline selection at `1304a54f`: `./gradlew :app:pixel2Api33AtdDebugAndroidTest --rerun -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=de.pyryco.mobile.ui.conversations.thread.BackgroundTaskPanelCaptureTest#compactLargeTextKeepsScrolledContentAndCloseGlyphReachable -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.disableAnimations=true --console=plain`. Exit **0**; fresh XML confirms **1 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors/skips**. The narrow selection omits the full sweep's sibling tests and cannot rule out order-dependent lifecycle behavior. Exact command, exit, log and copied XML are retained under `/tmp/verifier-1755/triage-current/`; the clean temporary worktree was removed. No open issue matched the exact failing method search. Conservative red routing applies.
- Ordering probe: `./gradlew --init-script /tmp/verifier-1755/triage-current/mixed-init.gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests de.pyryco.mobile.ui.conversations.thread.VerifierMixedErrorTest --console=plain`. Exit **1**, **1 executed/failed, 0 errors/skips**. Method: `archiveSecondSignalPrecedesLaterMarkdownFailure`. Scratch source, command, log and `mixed-results.xml` are retained in that same temporary folder; repository source is unchanged.
- The dispatcher passed the docs guard, script unit suite, `./gradlew check`, `./gradlew assembleDebug` and `./gradlew compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin`. These green gates were not rerun. It stopped before `scripted-all`; retained focused Offline Retry evidence is not a substitute for that full gate.
- Built on the complete preliminary source review and confirmed its three findings. Previous fixture isolation, enlarged Offline action-target repair and occurrence identities are present. Codegraph returned incomplete caller information; concrete repository callers supplied the check. Saved/dismissed-elsewhere feedback remains on SnackbarHost, while scoped failures retain client-owned copy. No new wire interaction or real-Claude-only acceptance is introduced, and existing live Offline Retry/reader Refresh scenarios are present. `needs-real-claude` is not required for this slice. The routine effort assessment remains appropriate.
- Retained latest focused evidence confirms **73 JVM passes with 2 skips** and **45 device passes with 2 skips**, zero failures/errors. Identical Archive/Refresh regressions executed and passed. Open #1760 tracks the retained pairing-touch failure; #1759 is still open, but its rendering repair is already in this checkout. Neither skip is counted as a pass.

### Visual evidence

Fetched current Figma screenshots for `685:4337`, `696:5101` and Error component `347:6619`, inspected both raw captures and comparison/overlay images, and checked exact inset crops. Both visible error containers occupy screen-area y=97..121 and end at x=392: 28dp below the measured 69dp header-through-rule, 24dp high, with the 20dp right gutter. They use the shared Error styling, shadow and padding without X/actions. The disclosed Archive hug-width difference is 6dp; reachable reader Refresh preserves “Couldn't open file” against the reference's Save-failed copy, as the plan permits.

Retained full-device command `./gradlew :app:pixel8Api35DebugAndroidTest --rerun '-Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#rowAndNoticeFramesAt412By892,de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#readerErrorFrameAt412By892' -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.requireRealSystemBars=true --console=plain` records exit **0**. `transient-errors-1747-device-results.xml` confirms **2 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors/skips**. The 2026-10-04 MainActivity captures have hardware acceleration, real bars, density/font scale 1 and 412×892 viewport metadata; thread insets are 24/24px and reader insets 24/63px. Comparison inputs are exact crops without resizing. Later occurrence/target changes do not alter these capture fixtures' notice geometry. Unrelated retained captures remain intact.

### Not checked

- Full baseline UI sweep and dispatcher `scripted-all` were not run by this verifier; scripted acceptance remains unexecuted after the red UI gate.
- Actual TalkBack speech, fresh light/dynamic palette pixels and fresh device recaptures were not exercised. No real-Claude suite was run.
- Neither ignored shared-screen method was independently rerun here. Restore the obsolete reader skip and obtain fresh nonzero device execution; #1760 remains a separate tracked failure.
- GitHub reports no remote checks; deterministic acceptance relies on the dispatcher's supplied results and local XML.

### Documentation handoff

- After implementation acceptance, update `app/src/androidTest/assets/design-1220/thread/index.md`'s Failure notice verdict from retained evidence, replacing its historical bottom-snackbar mismatch. Add the reader-error entry against `696:5101`, or update #1619's Reachable states (#1539) entry if it lands first. Record Refresh/open-failed versus reference Save-failed copy.
- Preserve unresolved Saved/dismissed-elsewhere discrepancies and #1619's non-error scope conflict.
- Fold measured placement, persistent-before-transient ordering, FIFO/full adjusted Short lifetime, Material accessibility flags, distinct identical occurrences and screen-exit cancellation into `thread-screen.md`, `thread-top-overlay.md` and `markdown-reader-screen.md`, retaining Saved behavior.
- Durable review lesson: FIFO inside a notice state orders callers that reach it, not signals left buffered in suspended collectors. Test interleaved production routes as well as repeated values on one route. Reassess bug-linked skips when their underlying fixes land.

### Summary

The visual migration and earlier repairs are sound, but cross-route failures can appear out of order. Repair that queue intake, record the authorized Archive scope revision, restore the obsolete reader regression, and resolve or properly triage the full UI failure before re-review. Documentation remains with the next stage after implementation acceptance.

## Verifier Review: #1747

**Decision: FAIL**
**Gates:** green; a focused review regression failed. Reviewed HEAD `b2b7eb85be912c170d1ae29ab7640201abf29138` against merge base `0273c411`; remote PR head matches.

### Findings

- [MUST FIX] `app/src/main/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/ThreadScreen.kt` → `ThreadScreen` error collectors: the previously reported mixed-route ordering defect remains. Each collector suspends inside `errorNotices.show` for the entire timeout. Archive A1, Archive A2, then markdown-open B consequently displays A1 → B → A2: A2 remains buffered in its source while B enters the common mutex queue. A fresh scratch Compose regression on this merged HEAD, `VerifierMixedErrorTest.archiveSecondSignalPrecedesLaterMarkdownFailure`, executed once and failed: after A1 expired, the pill contained “Couldn't open file” instead of the earlier second Archive failure. Consume signals promptly into the common ordered queue, retaining conversation/screen cancellation and a full adjusted Short lifetime per occurrence. Apply this consistently to new-session, archive, workspace, run-configuration, attachment refusal, attachment-send and markdown-open collectors; enqueue both refusal reasons together in their existing order so later routes cannot overtake the second reason. Add permanent mixed-route coverage through production collectors. Same-route occurrence tests and direct-state FIFO tests do not cover this defect.
- [MUST FIX] `app/src/androidTest/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/settings/ArchiveAppearanceCaptureTest.kt` → `ArchiveAppearanceCaptureTest.viewport` and `compactLargeTextKeepsRestoreReachable`, with `docs/specs/architecture/1747-transient-error-pills.md` → Files read / Revisions: the authorized operator repair `d5223aa5` replaces this sibling feature's viewport lifecycle with ordered `ViewportRule` and a compact `@Viewport`, but the plan still records neither the departure nor its validation. The [operator repair comment](https://github.com/pyrycode/pyrycode-mobile/pull/1755#issuecomment-5991754129) provides the scope, lifecycle rationale and full UI evidence; carry those into the plan. Current full UI evidence confirms all three Archive methods passed. This requests the missing plan record, not reversal of the authorized repair.
- [SHOULD FIX] `app/src/sharedTest/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/MarkdownReaderScreenTest.kt` → `copiesOfANoteAtTheReadersBound_areBounded`: re-evaluate and remove the obsolete #1759 ignore. Merged main includes `ef587984`, which addresses this exact 262,144-character unbroken-text memory trigger by breaking long runs only in drawn reader text, preserving original clipboard input. The PR still disables clipboard-bound assertions in both shared-test tiers. Restore the regression and obtain fresh nonzero execution on the device against the merged implementation. #1759 remains open, but its label/status is not a substitute for checking current code. The separate #1760 pairing-touch skip remains tied to an unresolved native overlap.

### Verification and visual evidence

- Accepted the dispatcher's green docs guard, script unit tests, `./gradlew check`, debug assembly, Android-test compilation, full UI and `scripted-all` gates without rerunning them. Before the focused diagnostic, unit XML recorded **4,271 executed/passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped**. Full UI command `ANDROID_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py ui` passed; `build/dispatcher-tests/ui-7gwns27r/dispatcher.xml` confirms **185 executed/passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped** (`RenameDialogCaptureTest.renameAtFigmaViewport`). `ANDROID_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py scripted-all` passed; `build/dispatcher-tests/scripted-all-j2_ksgj3/dispatcher.xml` confirms **14 executed/passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. The earlier full-gate failures are cleared by these fresh full results.
- Focused diagnostic command: `./gradlew --init-script /tmp/verifier-1755/triage-current/mixed-init.gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests de.pyryco.mobile.ui.conversations.thread.VerifierMixedErrorTest --console=plain`. Exit **1**; fresh `/tmp/verifier-1755/merged-mixed-results.xml` confirms **1 executed, 1 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped**, named above. Source and initialization script live outside the worktree; log is `/tmp/verifier-1755/merged-mixed-test.log`. The initial sandbox attempt could not acquire Gradle's wrapper lock and executed no tests; the authorized escalated run produced this result. No repository files were edited.
- Built on the preliminary source review and checked previous findings against remote review history. The merge resolution preserves main's attention-only overlay: the empty condition still includes `attentionPill == null`, adding `transientError == null` intentionally. Persistent notice ordering, safe client-owned copy, Saved/dismissed-elsewhere snackbar behavior, accessibility timeout flags, occurrence identity and repaired Offline target geometry otherwise retain their coverage. Codegraph caller results were incomplete; concrete repository searches and consumer reads supplied the checks.
- Inspected retained thread and reader side-by-side comparisons and independently checked the raw PNG crops against inset metadata. Both raw captures are **412×892**, density/font scale 1, static dark, API 35, hardware capture with real bars. Thread insets are 24/24px; reader insets are 24/63px. Screen-area crops are exact, without resizing. Both Error containers occupy **y=97..121**, ending at **x=392**: 28dp below the measured 69dp header, 24dp height and a 20dp right gutter. Styling reuses Error `NoticePill`, without X/actions. The disclosed thread hug-width difference is 6dp with existing Android metrics. Reader Refresh intentionally retains “Couldn't open file” against the reference's Save-failed copy, permitted by the plan.
- Retained capture command: `./gradlew :app:pixel8Api35DebugAndroidTest --rerun '-Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#rowAndNoticeFramesAt412By892,de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#readerErrorFrameAt412By892' -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.requireRealSystemBars=true --console=plain`, recorded exit **0**. `transient-errors-1747-device-results.xml` confirms **2 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors/skips**. PNGs, Figma references, comparisons and viewport/inset sidecars are retained. Later merge/menu/occurrence changes do not alter the reviewed error-pill placement; this is retained evidence, not a new capture on this HEAD. Unrelated captures remain intact.
- Audited retained failure/result evidence: the native reader run crashed at the bound; the native usage/Re-pair test reported 3.5px touch overlap. Latest retained identical-occurrence device evidence has **45 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped**; enlarged Retry evidence has **22 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped**. Neither skip is counted as a pass. Confirmed #1759 and #1760 are open. The routine effort assessment remains appropriate for this local presentation change; no new wire interaction or real-Claude-only criterion requires `needs-real-claude`. The existing Offline Retry scenario remains present.

### Not checked

- Fresh Figma screenshots: no callable Figma screenshot tool is available, and web access to both frame URLs failed. Visual assessment used retained 2026-10-04 exports and comparisons; current remote frame parity is unchecked.
- Actual TalkBack speech, fresh light/dynamic palette pixels and fresh full-device recaptures were not exercised. No emulator or live-Claude suite was run by this verifier.
- Neither ignored shared-screen method was independently rerun here. Restore and verify the reader-bound method after the merged fix; #1760 remains separately tracked. GitHub reports no remote checks; gate acceptance rests on dispatcher evidence.

### Documentation handoff

- After implementation acceptance, update `app/src/androidTest/assets/design-1220/thread/index.md`'s Failure notice verdict from retained evidence, replacing the historical bottom-snackbar mismatch. Add the reader-error entry against `696:5101`, or update #1619's Reachable states (#1539) entry if present by then. Record reachable Refresh/open-failed versus reference Save-failed copy.
- Preserve unresolved non-error Saved/dismissed-elsewhere discrepancies and #1619's scope conflict.
- Fold measured placement, persistent-before-transient ordering, full adjusted Short lifetime, Material accessibility flags, distinct identical occurrences and screen-exit cancellation into `thread-screen.md`, `thread-top-overlay.md` and `markdown-reader-screen.md`. Document FIFO once the mixed-route intake defect is repaired; retain Saved behavior.
- Durable review lessons: mutex FIFO only orders callers that reach it; buffered signals in suspended collectors can be overtaken. Test interleaved production routes. Reassess bug-linked skips after merging their underlying fixes.

### Summary

The requested visual migration matches retained design evidence, and full dispatcher gates are green. Repair mixed-route queue intake and record the authorized Archive plan revision before re-review; restore the stale reader regression as well. Documentation remains with the next stage after implementation acceptance.

## Verifier Review: #1747

**Decision: FAIL**
**Gates:** green. Reviewed PR head `c99648cf6cb7c12e6df4ef65821b3100f7fbd60e`.

### Findings
- [MUST FIX] `app/src/main/java/de/pyryco/mobile/ui/conversations/thread/ThreadScreen.kt` → `ThreadScreen`, `onImagesPasted`: the failure callback passed to `rememberPastedImageReceiver` still calls `snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(failure.text(resources))`. `AttachmentPicker.kt` → `capturePastedImage` reports `AttachmentSendFailure.TOO_LARGE` and `UNREADABLE` here, so oversized or unreadable pasted/keyboard-inserted images still produce bottom error snackbars and bypass the shared Error-pill FIFO. This violates the scoped attachment-size failure migration and the criterion that no scoped error reaches a SnackbarHost. Route this callback through `errorNotices`, preserving safe client-owned text, queue ordering and cancellation. Add a regression through the actual paste/keyboard-insertion callback proving both failures use an inert top pill and never the confirmation SnackbarHost. The new classification tests inject `attachmentSendFailures` directly; they cannot detect this separate route. Search of both screens found no other remaining error `showSnackbar` call: the other calls are the explicitly retained Saved and dismissed-elsewhere notices.
- [NIT] PR #1755 → Testing: the current body still describes `MarkdownReaderScreenTest.copiesOfANoteAtTheReadersBound_areBounded` (#1759) as ignored and lists two current known skips. Its ignore has been removed after main's repair, and the current JVM gate executes and passes it. Distinguish the historical two-skip evidence from the current source and results; #1760 remains the shared-suite skip.

### Verification evidence
- Dispatcher reports exit 0 for `scripts/docs-guard.sh`, `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts`, `./gradlew check`, `./gradlew assembleDebug`, `./gradlew compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin`, `ANDROID_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py ui`, and `ANDROID_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py scripted-all`. No green gate was rerun.
- Current JVM XML under `app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/`: **4298 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors, 1 skipped**. The skip is `ThreadTopOverlayTest.theUsagePill_sitsAboveThePairingPill_whichStartsRePair`, tied to unresolved #1760; it is not a pass.
- Current full UI XML, `build/dispatcher-tests/ui-c42xzhp3/dispatcher.xml` and `app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/managedDevice/debug/pixel2Api33Atd/TEST-pixel2Api33Atd_0-_app-.xml`: **185 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors, 1 skipped**, `RenameDialogCaptureTest.renameAtFigmaViewport`. All three Archive capture methods passed, including `compactLargeTextKeepsRestoreReachable`; the operator's viewport-before-activity repair preserves the assertions.
- Full scripted XML, `build/dispatcher-tests/scripted-all-8fizt_vx/dispatcher.xml`: **14 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors/skips**, including Offline Retry, switch-back and MCP flows. Zero real Claude turns.
- Retained full-device capture command: `./gradlew :app:pixel8Api35DebugAndroidTest --rerun '-Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#rowAndNoticeFramesAt412By892,de.pyryco.mobile.design.ThreadDesignCaptureTest#readerErrorFrameAt412By892' -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.requireRealSystemBars=true --console=plain`. Recorded exit 0; retained `transient-errors-1747-device-results.xml` confirms **2 executed/passed, 0 failures/errors/skips**, both named methods. PNGs, comparisons and sidecars are present under `app/src/androidTest/assets/design-1220/thread/`; API 35, 412×892, density/font scale 1, real bars, no IME.
- Fetched current Figma screenshots for `685:4337`, `696:5101` and Error pill `347:6619` and visually inspected the retained comparisons. Both inert pills have no X, sit 97dp below the app-area top (28dp below the measured 69dp header), end at the 20dp right gutter and have 24dp visible height. Error colours, rounded corners and shadow match. The thread's text-hug width is 6dp wider with existing shared Android typography; the reader deliberately shows reachable Refresh/open-failed copy against the Save-failed reference, as the plan documents. These do not add blocking visual findings.
- Merge resolution confirmed: `ThreadTopOverlay` retains main's attention-aware empty guard and attention-first order. The additional `transientError` guard condition intentionally permits a transient-only overlay. No flagged main behaviour was lost. Source search supplemented the incomplete codegraph caller results.

### Not checked
- No live-Claude suite was run. This slice presents existing local failures without a new daemon interaction; its acceptance and captures are deterministic, so `needs-real-claude` is not required.
- The paste failure was confirmed from its concrete producer, screen callback and test coverage rather than a new device reproduction.

### Documentation handoff
- Update `app/src/androidTest/assets/design-1220/thread/index.md`'s Failure notice verdict from the retained evidence; it still describes the old bottom snackbar. Add the reader-error entry, or update the Reachable states (#1539) entry if present when documentation runs. Record the Refresh/open-failed versus reference Save-failed copy and the existing font-metric width difference.
- Preserve the unresolved Saved and dismissed-elsewhere design discrepancies and #1619's non-error scope conflict.
- Fold measured placement, persistent-before-transient ordering, 12dp visible gaps, FIFO intake, distinct repeated occurrences, full Short timeout with Material accessibility flags, and screen/conversation cancellation into `thread-screen.md`, `thread-top-overlay.md` and `markdown-reader-screen.md`. Keep Saved behaviour explicit.

### Summary
The migrated routes, queue and requested captures are supported by green evidence, but paste/keyboard-insertion failures remain on the old bottom error path. Fix that callback and cover it through the production route before re-review. The routine risk assessment remains appropriate. Durable lesson: testing a shared failure flow does not cover a local callback that independently presents the same failure classification.
